name: indicator-lab
description: Backtest 13 technical indicators (RSI, MACD, Bollinger, stochastic, ADX, CCI, WilliamsR, MFI, ATR, OBV + variants) against SPY/QQQ on 5-year daily data. Tests singles, pairs, and triple combinations ranked by Sharpe/return/max DD. Built on pandas-ta with 130+ indicators available. Zero competition on ClawHub.
author: bisonquant
